name: Banani
tagline: Text-to-UI: prompt to editable multi-screen prototype.
description: Banani is an AI UI design tool that turns a plain-language description, screenshot, or design reference into editable, multi-screen prototypes in seconds. You refine the result with prompts or manual edits, add click interactions, and export to Figma, HTML/CSS, or images. It targets founders, PMs, and non-designers who need fast mockups.
edge: Turns a plain-language prompt into editable, multi-screen prototypes and exports straight to Figma or HTML/CSS.
cons: AI output still needs manual polish
